readme.markdown:
# Klarefi MCP

Klarefi completes regulated intake work before a person reviews the case. The
MCP server can guide applicants, read cited case files, manage workflow drafts,
and run approved connector actions. It does not decide a case.

## Hosted server

Use the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint:

```text
https://www.klarefi.com/mcp
```

[Choose an MCP client and connect Klarefi](https://install.apicommons.org/?server=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.klarefi.com%2F.well-known%2Fmcp%2Fserver.json)

Customer tools require this header:

```text
Authorization: Bearer KLAREFI_API_KEY
```

Applicant tools can use a signed intake URL without an API key.

## Client packages

This repository includes ready-to-publish metadata for Codex, Claude, Cursor,
and Antigravity. Each package connects to the same hosted server.

- Codex: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and `.mcp.json`
- Claude: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `mcp.json`
- Cursor: `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` and `mcp.json`
- Antigravity: `plugin.json` and `mcp_config.json`
- MCP Registry: `server.json`

For a local stdio client, run `bunx --bun @klarefi/mcp`.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://www.klarefi.com/docs/guides/agent-intake)
- [Privacy](https://www.klarefi.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.klarefi.com/terms)
- [Support](mailto:support@klarefi.com)

toolsPreview.name: create_connector_from_openapi
toolsPreview.description: Import a public OpenAPI JSON URL as a Klarefi verification connector. JSON specs only (convert YAML first). The connector goes live immediately — review its functions before routing live traffic.

toolsPreview.name: create_connector
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a Klarefi verification connector manifest. The connector is active as soon as this returns — there is no draft/review step, so review its functions before routing live traffic.

toolsPreview.name: delete_connector
toolsPreview.description: Delete a configured Klarefi connector by key.

toolsPreview.name: create_intake_session
toolsPreview.description: Create a hosted Klarefi intake session.

toolsPreview.name: get_case
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a Klarefi case and resolved facts.

toolsPreview.name: list_operator_queue
toolsPreview.description: List the bounded Klarefi operator queue for this API key's environment. Requires cases:review.

toolsPreview.name: get_case_workspace
toolsPreview.description: Inspect a case workspace with facts, cited evidence, blockers, ownership, and timeline. This does not mutate the case.

toolsPreview.name: get_case_package
toolsPreview.description: Get the cited case_package.v1 artifact and a signed read-only case-file URL.

toolsPreview.name: submit_case_review
toolsPreview.description: Submit an auditable intake-review command. Allowed commands review or correct facts, request clarification, update evidence, or escalate. This tool cannot complete or reopen a case.

toolsPreview.name: get_review_command
toolsPreview.description: Poll the status and result of an intake-review command.

toolsPreview.name: list_workflows
toolsPreview.description: List versioned Form · Fact · Verify workflow declarations.

toolsPreview.name: save_workflow_draft
toolsPreview.description: Validate and save a workflow declaration as a draft. This tool cannot publish or activate the workflow.

toolsPreview.name: open_intake
toolsPreview.description: Read an applicant intake from a signed URL or from session_id plus access_token. No Klarefi API key is required. On the hosted MCP endpoint, include the same intake credential in each later intake tool call.

toolsPreview.name: get_intake_state
toolsPreview.description: Get the current applicant intake state. Pass url, or session_id with access_token, on the hosted MCP endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: answer_question
toolsPreview.description: Answer the active applicant question with free text, optionally targeting a task_id.

toolsPreview.name: answer_fields
toolsPreview.description: Answer structured requested facts by fact_id. Values must be strings; yes_no fields take "yes" or "no", and date fields use YYYY-MM-DD.

toolsPreview.name: upload_document
toolsPreview.description: Upload a requested applicant document. Use content_base64 on the hosted MCP endpoint. Local stdio clients can use file_path. Inline content is limited to 5MB decoded; local files can be up to 25MB.

toolsPreview.name: submit_intake
toolsPreview.description: Submit the applicant intake. Returns submitted, blockers, and the fresh intake state.

toolsPreview.name: save_intake_draft
toolsPreview.description: Save applicant form draft fields without submitting. Field values must be strings or null.

toolsPreview.name: wait_for_next_action
toolsPreview.description: Poll until the intake leaves processing or the timeout expires. If timed_out is true, call wait_for_next_action again.
